abstract: In this report, we describe bilateral gonadal tumors with characteristic histopathological findings in a patient with Turner's syndrome who had 45,X/46,X, +mar mosaicism. The left gonad contained a gonadoblastoma and a remnant of streak gonad. The right gonad was entirely replaced by a 15x11x7-cm solid and cystic tumor, which was revealed to be a combination of a mixed germ cell tumor and a cavernous hemangiomatous lesion. The latter occupied approximately half of the entire tumor volume, and there was an incomplete boundary between it and the mixed germ cell tumor lesion. To our knowledge, this is the first reported case of Turner's syndrome with a combination of a mixed germ cell tumor and a hemangiomatous lesion in the gonad.
abstract_ja: ターナー症候群と45,X/46,X,+marモザイクを有する患者に、特徴的な組織学的所見を伴う両側性性腺腫瘍が認められた。左性腺には性腺芽腫と索状性腺の遺残が含まれていた。右性腺は15×11×7cmの充実性・嚢胞性腫瘍に完全に置換されていた。これは混合型胚細胞腫瘍と海海綿状血管腫様病変の合併であった。後者は腫瘍容積の約半分を占め、両者の境界は不完全であった。我々の知る限り、ターナー症候群の性腺に混合型胚細胞腫瘍と血管腫様病変が合併した初めての報告である。
